```sql
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', fecha) AS mes,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN estado = 'cancelado' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*), 4) AS tasa_cancelacion
FROM pedidos
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', fecha) BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-04'
GROUP BY mes
ORDER BY mes;
```
